headlines.title: 구윤철 " 정부, 외환시장 24시간 모니터링 … 다른 개혁도 차질없이 추진 "

headlines.title: 서비스업도 R&D 지원 …‘ AI 에이전틱 커머스 ’ 시장 키운다
headlines.summary: [서비스산업기본법 제정 속도] 제조업 중심 산업 지원체계 손질 부처 칸막이 규제 조정 근거 마련 경제계 “도약 위한 제도 기반 돼야” 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 6일 서울 중구 웨스틴 조선 서울에서 열린 서비스산업 경쟁력 강화 TF 2차회의에서 모두발언을 하고있다.

headlines.title: ‘반도체 추가세수’ 수십조 미래대응기금 …다음주 청사진 나온다
headlines.summary: 기금 규모·활용처 관심 관람객이 전시된 반도체 웨이퍼를 바라보고 있다. 연합뉴스 청와대가 반도체 호황에 따른 추가세수를 바탕으로 한 미래대응기금을 신설하기로 하면서, 구체적인 기금 규모 및 활용처에 대한 관심이 쏠린다. 정부가 미래 성장과 양극화, 청년 지원 등 넓은 지출 분야에 쓰기로 밝힌 터라, 지출의 칸막이가 필요하다는 지적도 나온다.

headlines.title: 추경 편성 없이 미래대응기금 활용 포석 [3대 메가프로젝트 속도전]
headlines.summary: ‘초과→추가 세수’로 용어 변경 이유 초과 세수, 세출 추가 땐 추경 필요 정부 세수 예측 실패 전제도 회피 野 “국가 재정을 ‘정권 쌈짓돈’으로” 정부가 미래대응기금 신설 추진 방침을 밝히면서 그간 써왔던 ‘초과세수’ 대신 ‘추가세수’로 용어를 바꾼 배경에 관심이 쏠린다.

headlines.title: 올 추가세수 50조, 미래기금 투입하려면 법 고쳐야
headlines.summary: '추가세수 활용' 주요 쟁점은 법 적용 아닌 상황, 산정방식 모호 내년부터 집행시 올해 추경 불필요 "사회안전망 강화에도 재원 투입해야" [세종=이데일리 서대웅 하상렬 기자] 정부가 추가세수를 ‘미래대응기금’에 적립해 3대 메가프로젝트 등의 투자 재원으로 활용하겠다고 공식화하며 무엇을 추가세수로 볼 것인지가 최대 쟁점으로 떠올랐다.

headlines.title: 초과세수 기대 속 정부 '한은 마통' 4년 만에 최소
headlines.summary: 1∼6월 누적 44조1천억원, 월 평균 7조3천500억원…이자액 214억원 정부 측 "적정 시기에 세수 잘 들어와" [연합뉴스 자료사진. DB 및 재판매 금지] (서울=연합뉴스) 한지훈 이대희 기자 = 올해 상반기(1∼6월) 정부가 한국은행에서 빌려 쓴 자금 규모가 4년 만에 가장 작았던 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 복지도 산업도 세액공제 대신 보조금 으로?···청년·저소득층 혜택 늘...
headlines.summary: 이재명 대통령이 이준헌 기자 혼인 세액공제 등 복지정책은 물론 국내 생산촉진세제 등 산업정책에서도 세금을 깎아주는 대신 보조금 등을 지급하는 방안이 거론되고 있다. 보조금 형태로 지원 방식이 바뀌면 청년·저소득층으로선 혜택이 커질 수 있을 것으로 기대된다. 다만, 예상치 못한 부작용이 발생할 수 있는 만큼 점진적인 전환이 필요하다는 제언이 나온다.

headlines.title: 종부세 상위 10%가 87%를 부담 … 개인 중 절반은 60세 이상
headlines.summary: 60세 이상 1인당 종부세 264만원 내…미성년 납세자 363명 개인 종부세 절반은 60세 이상 (서울=연합뉴스) 이진욱 기자 = 사진은 30일 서울 송파구 한 부동산 중개업소에 세금 관련 안내문이 붙어 있는 모습. 2026.6.30 cityboy@yna.co.

headlines.title: 전월세 폭등에 버거워진 서울살이 … 청년들 경기도로 밀려나
headlines.summary: 서울 전세부족 5년반來 최고 전셋값 상승률 작년 5배달해 실거주자 수요 매매로 이동 1분기 서울→경기전입 8.4만명 서울 전월세 부담이 커지면서 무주택자와 젊은 층이 서울 바깥으로 밀려나고 있다.

headlines.title: ‘脫 서울 ’ 10명 중 6명은 경기로 떠났다
headlines.summary: 서울 전출자 60.46% 경기행…주택 사유가 최다 고양·성남·용인 등 집중…경기권 분양도 잇따라 서울 송파구 롯데월드타워에서 바라본 아파트 단지 모습. 연합뉴스 서울 집값 부담이 커지면서 경기 지역으로 이동하는 ‘탈서울’ 흐름이 이어지고 있다.

headlines.title: [단독] 30대 가계빚, 12년만에 2배로 … 사상 첫 '평균 대출 1억' 돌파
headlines.summary: 2030 가계대출 12년간 90%↑ 생활비 부담에 목돈대출 연령 점차 낮아져 청년층의 고용·소득난이 심화되면서 가계대출 부담 또한 역대 최고 수준으로 치솟고 있다. 특히 30대 가계대출 규모는 12년 만에 두 배 가까이 불어났으며, 1인당 평균 대출액은 1억원을 돌파했다.

headlines.title: 20년 넘은 맛집도 사라져
headlines.summary: 내수 부진에 2797곳 문 닫아 고물가와 내수 부진 등으로 지난해 기준 20년 이상 영업해온 음식점 중 폐업한 곳이 약 2800곳에 달한 것으로 집계됐다. 6일 국세청에 따르면, 지난해 기준 5년 이상 존속한 음식점 폐업은 4만1569곳으로 비교가 가능한 2007년 이후 최대로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 근로자 절반, 임금보다 물가가 더 올랐다

headlines.title: 전국 휘발유값 석달 만에 1800원대로
headlines.summary: 최고가격제·유가 안정화 영향 경유 평균 가격도 ℓ당 1886원 7차 석유 최고가격제 시행과 국제 유가 안정화 등의 영향으로 전국 주유소 기름값이 하락세를 이어가면서 국내 휘발유 가격이 3개월여 만에 1800원대로 낮아졌다. 6일 한국석유공사 유가정보서비스 오피넷에 따르면 이날 낮 12시 기준 전국 주유소 평균 휘발유 판매가격은 ℓ당 1898.

key_headlines.title: Government to Establish Future Response Fund from Semiconductor Surplus Tax Revenue
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's government plans to create a future response fund based on additional tax revenues from the semiconductor boom, with details on fund size and allocation to be announced next week. The fund will reportedly support future growth, income inequality reduction, and youth support programs.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Rental Crisis Pushes Young People to Gyeonggi Province
key_headlines.summary: Rising jeonse (long-term lease) and monthly rent prices in Seoul are forcing renters and young people to relocate to Gyeonggi Province, with 84,000 people moving from Seoul to Gyeonggi in Q1 2026. Seoul's jeonse shortage has reached a 5.5-year high with price increases five times greater than last year.

key_headlines.title: Korea Introduces 24-Hour Currency Trading to Support Won Internationalization
key_headlines.summary: South Korea has launched extended forex trading from Monday 6 AM to Saturday 6 AM, allowing continuous won trading and helping businesses manage exchange rate risks. The move is welcomed by companies, foreign investors, and Korean families abroad seeking to reduce currency trading inconvenience.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Collapses Below 8,000 Despite Samsung's Record Earnings
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI fell below 8,000 and later retreated to the 7,400 level as circuit breakers were triggered for the sixth time this year, despite Samsung Electronics reporting record quarterly earnings. Market weakness was attributed to profit-taking and expectations being priced in beforehand.

key_headlines.title: Government's Reliance on Central Bank Loans Hits 4-Year Low Amid Surplus Tax Revenue
key_headlines.summary: The government borrowed only 44.1 trillion won from the Bank of Korea in the first half of 2026, the lowest in 4 years, as tax revenues came in as planned. This reflects improved fiscal conditions with additional tax collections exceeding 50 trillion won this year.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's government is establishing a major future response fund capitalizing on surplus tax revenues from the semiconductor industry boom, with structural details to be announced next week. Rising jeonse and monthly rental costs in Seoul are creating significant affordability challenges, forcing younger and lower-income residents to migrate to Gyeonggi Province in record numbers. The government's surplus tax collection has reached over 50 trillion won this year, reducing reliance on central bank borrowing to 4-year lows. These developments highlight both fiscal opportunities and emerging social challenges as Korea navigates economic growth with widening regional and generational inequality pressures.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea's monetary policy committee is approaching a critical decision point regarding interest rate adjustments, with rate hike indicators previously pointing in a unified direction now shifting. The consumer price index methodology is being updated for the first time in five years, replacing outdated items like peanuts and balloon flowers with modern consumption items including cloud services, maratang (spicy noodles), smartwatches, and electric vehicle charging fees. The government faces a key policy challenge in defining what constitutes additional tax revenue for the future response fund, as definition and calculation methodology ambiguity could impact budget allocation. These changes reflect efforts to modernize economic measurement and fiscal policy implementation amid rapid economic and consumption pattern shifts.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI experienced significant volatility, falling below 8,000 and triggering circuit breakers six times in 2026 despite Samsung Electronics posting record quarterly earnings, suggesting profit-taking and dampened investor sentiment. Savings banks are aggressively competing for deposits with fixed-rate accounts exceeding 4% annualized returns, with over 150 such products now available as investors flee volatile equities. Foreign investor flows, exchange rates, and artificial intelligence capital expenditure trends are emerging as complex factors driving market movements, with concerns about gray swan risks including Chinese semiconductor competition and interest rate volatility. The KOSDAQ also declined sharply, falling 3.23% as broader market weakness affected both domestic and foreign investment sentiment.
sections.Industry & Technology: Sinopex is expanding electric vehicle battery flexible printed circuit board (FPCB) production through 150 billion won in equipment investment across two phases in Vietnam, targeting mass production readiness by 2027. Kyungpook National University researchers have developed design principles for next-generation high-capacity batteries applicable to 1,000+ kilometer electric vehicles, energy storage systems, solid-state batteries, and physical AI systems like humanoid robots. Morgan Stanley's semiconductor analysis has turned cautious, prompting recommendations to sell Samsung and SK Hynix stocks, though biotech and consumer goods sectors are viewed as attractive given potential rate declines and M&A expansion opportunities.
sections.Real Estate: Apartment jeonse (long-term lease) to-price ratios have risen continuously for 10 consecutive months, reaching 68.9% nationally as of May 2026, triggering consumer demand shifts toward purchase contracts in areas with strong fundamental demand. Apartment lease-sale transaction volumes have dropped 7.2% year-over-year, while villa and multi-unit housing transactions increased 11.5%, indicating tenants seeking alternative housing options amid high-end apartment rental costs. The National Tax Service has pursued significant tax evasion cases involving one-house non-taxation benefits, recovering 3.18 billion won through investigations into name-transfer schemes to artificially qualify for tax exemptions. Developers are emphasizing financing-backed new apartments as rising jeonse rates push price-conscious renters toward property purchase rather than long-term leasing options.
sections.International Economy: The Dow Jones index broke through the 53,000 level for the first time, driven by semiconductor and artificial intelligence company stock gains including Broadcom and AMD, signaling strong U.S. equity market momentum. Market participants are closely monitoring the June Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting minutes scheduled for release on July 8, which will provide crucial signals regarding the Federal Reserve's future interest rate path. Walmart announced significant price reductions including 50% cherry discounts and 33% cola price cuts, prompting U.S. President Trump's approval as deflationary pressures continue despite Fed acknowledgment that supply shocks keep inflation above the 2% target. Geopolitical tensions have extended to FIFA governance, with the Trump administration intervening in World Cup-related matters, drawing European government concerns about sovereignty and international norm violations.
sections.AI & Economy: The Korean Chamber of Commerce and Industry convened discussions on AI's labor market transformation, emphasizing the need for new employment paradigms as artificial intelligence reshapes the workforce landscape. The government has revived the stalled 14-year-old Service Industry Development Basic Law initiative to accelerate AI and manufacturing convergence, aiming to revolutionize retail and public sector services beyond simple deregulation. The Korea Securities Depository is conducting internal AI agent development competitions to accelerate digital and AI transformation while improving work efficiency among employees. The Ministry of Employment and Labor is deploying AI-based risk assessment systems to prevent industrial accidents, showcasing how artificial intelligence can enhance workplace safety and advance the adoption of risk evaluation practices across industries.
sections.Others: Intel-backed artificial intelligence semiconductor manufacturer Syntiant Corporation has filed for initial public offering (IPO) on the U.S. stock market, signaling investor confidence in specialized AI chip production beyond dominant incumbents. Hyundai Motor Group has committed to paying supplier invoices within 10 days, positioning faster payments as part of Korea's transition toward advanced economic systems while supporting ecosystem partners. Big Tech executives have reversed previous predictions of AI-driven mass unemployment, acknowledging that human workers remain essential; historical analysis suggests 85% of jobs created over the past 80 years resulted from technological advancement. Korea has achieved independent unmanned aircraft engine production capability through Hanwha Aerospace, resolving previous reliance on imported engines and associated export restrictions that had limited drone and aircraft sales internationally.
